g.aria-label: Monte Carlo Target R_t: Wait for Episode End (Unbiased, High Var)
R_t = r_t + γ r_{t+1} + γ² r_{t+2} + ··· + γ^{T−t−1} r_{T−1} (full tail sum)
One-Step TD Target y_t: Bootstrap After 1 Step (Online, Low Var)
y_t = r_t + γ max_{a'} Q(s_{t+1}, a')
Updates Q(s_t, a_t) immediately; trades tail noise for current table bias
